label: Open catalog
summary: Load a descriptor and its linked catalog tree.

label: Inspect or export catalog
summary: Inspect a selected scope, filter entries, and export text or JSON.

label: Set active descriptor
summary: Save the descriptor selection that later CLI commands will use.

label: Add an entry
summary: Validate a new resource, catalog, or link and review its physical parent.

label: Edit descriptor
summary: Review changes to the authored fields in their physical descriptor.

label: Resolve locations
summary: Infer metadata offline, inspect the diff, or request a credentialed check.

label: Preview discovery scope
summary: Inspect remote roots, path templates, captured fields, and local destinations.

label: Find remote matches
summary: List matching remote metadata and prepare a concrete catalog for review.

label: Save discovered catalog
summary: Save the reviewed matches as YAML or JSON for a subsequent pull.

label: Authentication guide
summary: Choose authentication setup or explain the profile selected for a remote location.

label: List profiles
summary: Read profile names, providers, and authentication modes.

label: Inspect a profile
summary: Read configuration and credential references.

label: Configure a profile
summary: Validate a provider and mode, then save credential references.

label: Remove a profile
summary: Remove the saved profile and its Fileroute token cache.

label: Check credentials or read access
summary: Request a credentials check or a read-access check for a provider URL.

label: Google Drive sign-in
summary: Use a saved profile or review legacy installed-app OAuth options.

label: Microsoft sign-in
summary: Review a saved or legacy Microsoft Graph authentication flow.

label: SharePoint sign-in
summary: Review SharePoint authentication through the Microsoft Graph flow.

label: S3 credentials check
summary: Validate a saved S3 profile through the native AWS credential chain.

label: Preview transfer
summary: Inspect planned routes for a resource, subtree, or entire descriptor.

label: Run reviewed transfer
summary: Submit a reviewed plan for comparison and confirmation, then track the job.

label: Generate diagram
summary: Preview or export the catalog graph as SVG, HTML, Markdown, or Mermaid.

label: Clone descriptor
summary: Preview or copy an authored descriptor to a new path, with optional overwrite.

label: Migrate legacy descriptors
summary: Preview a converted legacy catalog and its linked files before writing.

label: Inspect a job
summary: Retrieve queued, running, succeeded, or failed status for a local job.

label: Review local approval
summary: Bind explicit local approval to one operation and its reviewed inputs.

label: View command help
summary: Look up help for a registered command and its options.

label: Show completion script
summary: Generate the selected shell script using Typer.

label: Install completion
summary: Review a request to install completion in the local shell configuration.
